frozen: Every value below was fixed before any candidate or comparator was scored on a held-out window. run_study.py refuses to score when this file's sha256 differs from PROTOCOL_SHA256.

data.source: Hyperliquid mainnet 4h BTC, ETH and SOL perpetual candles and hourly funding, frozen by backtest/candidates/chaikin_money_flow_1649 (#1649) and copied byte for byte into data/; no new data was acquired
data.prior_use: Twenty-one earlier studies pin the same BTC 4h candle file (sha256 89f84288d462b830ceba8108ea9d69db4d3dac417c730dc9cdd13271c10fd0f8) and score the same held-out span [2025-09-01, 2026-09-01): aroon_trend_1643, awesome_oscillator_1660, bitcoin_lead_lag_1640 (4h), calendar_conditioned_entry_1653, camarilla_pivot_reversal_1669, chaikin_money_flow_1649, commodity_channel_trend_1656, connors_rsi_reversion_1645, elder_force_pullback_1668, elder_ray_pullback_1648, fisher_reversal_1646, klinger_divergence_1662, mass_index_reversal_1670, money_flow_index_reversal_1658, on_balance_volume_divergence_1657, regression_channel_reversion_1644, relative_vigor_index_1666, schaff_trend_cycle_1651, stochastic_momentum_index_1663, vortex_trend_1647 and williams_r_reversal_1650. This study's test window is therefore chronological retrospective evidence; it is not claimed to be previously unseen data.

windows.warmup: the manifest's 300 bars before each window start feed indicators only and are never scored

execution.fills: a bar-N signal fills at the bar N+1 open; no reversal and no scale-in while a position is open
execution.costs: manifest taker and maker fees, per-coin half spread plus slippage, lot rounding to szDecimals and the venue minimum order value through the manifest execution_spec
execution.stress_note: the stress run doubles spread and slippage; fees stay at the manifest values

price_only_control.definition: study-local adapter over the same evaluator core with the relative-volume predicate removed before the current and previous qualified conditions are computed; data validity (including volume validity over vol_period), the body filter, platform behavior and execution rules stay the same; no production strategy or bypass parameter is registered

multiplier_one_arm.definition: the candidate grid restricted to vol_multiplier = 1.0 (it still requires relative volume strictly above 1; it is a sensitivity arm and not a volume-free control)

session_breakout.mapping: break of the prior trading session's high or low with volume confirmation; lookback counts sessions, not bars; volume_threshold is its native volume ratio

volume_weighted.mapping: price cross of an SMA of sma_period bars with volume above vol_multiplier times its SMA; sma_period is not a range lookback

breakout.mapping: rolling lookback-bar range breakout gated by true-range expansion (atr_period, atr_multiplier); reads no volume

donchian_breakout.mapping: Donchian channel break over entry_period bars; exit_period has no effect under the explicit close owner

chaikin_money_flow_breakout.mapping: rolling breakout_window-bar range breakout confirmed by candle-estimated money flow over flow_window bars

incumbent_reference: M1 incumbents run under each arm's matched close, stop and direction contract through eval_windows incumbent_contract; descriptive only, never a verdict input

selection.eligibility: all three datasets scored, candle and funding coverage complete, no liquidated leg, and at least min_train_clusters independent position clusters
selection.rule: highest mean net Sharpe across datasets, then highest mean drawdown-adjusted return, then earliest grid order

independent_positions: every position of an arm in one window is an interval [entry_date, exit_date]; intervals from all datasets are merged when they overlap or touch, and each merged interval counts once as an independent position cluster
parity_gates: the candidate and price-only control signals equal an independent per-bar reference on every dataset frame (train and test, warm-up included) for the selected parameters
the selected candidate_both decisions match the 200-bar live check window on every dataset's held-out frame with the matched close and stop owner (parity_diff, futures registry, strict)

inconclusive_when: candle or funding coverage is incomplete for any arm in a matched comparison
any arm in a matched comparison has no eligible train selection
candidate_both has fewer than min_test_clusters independent held-out clusters
pass_requires_all: candidate_both mean held-out net return > 0 at cost x1
candidate_both mean held-out net return > 0 at cost x2
in each matched contract, the candidate mean held-out net return is higher than the price-only control and every comparator
candidate_both worst quarterly max drawdown is no worse than the price_only_both and every bidirectional comparator worst quarterly max drawdown
the median held-out mean net return of the selected candidate_both parameters' one-step grid neighbors is > 0
verdict.fail_when: the evidence is adequate (no inconclusive condition) and any pass requirement is false
verdict.admission: a pass, fail or inconclusive verdict changes no admission, default or live configuration; the strategy stays edge_status=no_edge
